answer: Because the reef reference is updated at each sonnet checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the wander audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism hence earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 32 aliases however many keys the operator holds. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 5 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
